text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a three-day rally that's pushed the stock up $6 from its early-November low. The climb follows a spike in heating oil prices—up 59% year-over-year—and reflects broader energy strength as oil has steadied around $90 per barrel globally. The stock has also benefited from what appears to be positive investor sentiment on the sector, with the company mentioned alongside peers in major investment discussions this week.

That said, the longer view is murkier: the stock is still down 7.6% over two weeks, and recent headlines also point to headwinds—Russian crude production has rebounded to levels that are putting global oil markets back into surplus rather than the tight conditions that typically support prices. The recent rally may be a bounce within a broader softening trend for the sector.
